title: What Is Metaphysics?
summary: Aristotle called it 'first philosophy': the study of being as such.
body:
Metaphysics asks what exists; ontology catalogs it. From Aristotle's categories to OWL web ontologies, the field spans pure philosophy and working knowledge graphs.

Aristotle called it 'first philosophy': the study of being as such. Questions: What exists? What is causation? Is time real? The field divides into ontology (what there is) and metaphysics proper (how it hangs together).

title: Quine: 'On What There Is'
summary: W.
body:
W.V.O. Quine (1948): 'To be is to be the value of a bound variable.' Existence = what our best theories quantify over. Ontological commitment follows from the theories we accept — no more, no less.

title: Universals: Do Properties Exist?
summary: Does 'redness' exist, or only red things? Realists (Plato, Armstrong) say universals are real; nominalists (Quine, Lewis) say only particulars exist.
body:
Does 'redness' exist, or only red things? Realists (Plato, Armstrong) say universals are real; nominalists (Quine, Lewis) say only particulars exist. The oldest debate in metaphysics, still live.

title: Presentism vs. Eternalism
summary: Is only the present real (presentism), or are past and future equally real (eternalism/block universe)? Physics (relativity's block) favors eternalism; experience favors presentism.

title: Causation: What Is It?

body:
